name: runtime-evidence-view
goal: The shared viewer shows recorded runtime evidence beside designs: one current capture at a branch tip, before and after at a commit, read and hash-checked through the bridge.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Viewer showed designs only. Spec: specification/features/planned/runtime-evidence-view.md; contract note work/runtime-evidence-contract.md; types from DesktopEvidence.types.ts.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Final ui-evidence specs on the viewer before the change, isolated copy: 23 failed of 23. /tmp/harness-runtime-evidence-red-final.log. Review fixes red: 6 failed, 1 control passed.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Overview default, Designs and Evidence sections, evidence store, runtime screens, behaviour, audio and coverage panels, verdict mark, word names, proved commit links. 16 new units.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged tests on the final tree: desktop UI 58 passed, hub UI 19, focused unit 90. Review tests unchanged since red. Hashes /tmp/harness-runtime-evidence-hashes.txt; logs /tmp/harness-runtime-evidence-*-final.log.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
